hooks.name: TechLead No Build/Test
hooks.description: Hard-blocks the TechLead orchestrator from running dotnet build or dotnet test. Verification belongs to subagents.

action.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$json = $input | Out-String | ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd = [string]$json.tool_input.command; $lines = $cmd -split '[;\n]' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -match '^(\.?\.?[/\\]?[^\s]*dotnet|dotnet)\s+(build|test)' }; if ($lines.Count -gt 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('BLOCKED: TechLead may not run dotnet build/test. Delegate verification to a subagent via run_workflow.'); exit 2 }; exit 0"
